slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can purchases made in a given month be sold in that same month, or must a unit be purchased in one month and only become available for sale starting the next month?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about intra-month purchase timing and same-month availability, which directly targets when purchases occur relative to sales.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden P1 slot was resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; no unresolved P0 or P1 slots remained.

summary: The agent asked focused clarification questions and explicitly resolved the hidden purchase-timing slot before modeling, leading to an appropriate stop with no silent assumptions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
